_about: Hand-labelled set for the IQF mapping shortlist (DEC-023). Per demo standard (packages/db/fixtures/<name>.json): external requirement code -> codes of the generic starting template's items (packages/core/src/framework/internal-template.ts) that answer it, completely or in part. The demo data has no requirement mappings of its own (only glossary terms), so these labels are the set. Conservative: a requirement is listed only where its wording makes the answer clear. The Arabic standard is labelled too: lexical ranking cannot meet Arabic wording against English items, which is what embeddings are for.
